info:
# 🔋 Full Charge Control (Victron / DVCC)

Controls the DVCC charge voltage of a Victron battery system with JK-BMS.

## Operating Modes
| Mode     | Behaviour                                                  |
|----------|------------------------------------------------------------|
| `auto`   | Full charge every N calendar weeks (→ FULL_CHARGE_INTERVAL) |
| `manual` | Forces full charge immediately (DVCC = 0 V / RCV)         |
| `bulk`   | Permanent conservation charge (Float = FLOAT_VOLTAGE)      |

## Charge Modes
| Mode          | Description                                                                              |
|---------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| CVL Mode      | Full charge detection via JK-BMS CVL voltage drop (DELTA_V)                              |
| Autonomous    | DVCC sets RCV_VOLTAGE; voltage reached → hold timer; after RCV_TIME_MIN min → Float      |

## Parameters in Logic Node
- `DELTA_V`              = 0.5 V    — CVL drop detection (CVL mode only)
- `FLOAT_VOLTAGE`        = 53.9 V   — Conservation charge voltage
- `FULL_CHARGE_INTERVAL` = 2        — Full charge every N calendar weeks
- `AUTONOMOUS_MODE`      = false    — false: CVL mode | true: Autonomous mode
- `RCV_VOLTAGE`          = 55.2 V   — Full charge voltage (autonomous mode)
- `RCV_DETECT_DELTA`     = 0.2 V    — Voltage tolerance for RCV detection (autonomous mode)
- `RCV_TIME_MIN`         = 120 min  — Hold time at RCV voltage (autonomous mode)

## Paths
- History: `/data/home/nodered/.node-red/history/volladung_history.json`
- DVCC:    `com.victronenergy.settings → /Settings/SystemSetup/MaxChargeVoltage`
- CVL:     `com.victronenergy.battery/512 → /Info/MaxChargeVoltage`
- Voltage: `com.victronenergy.battery/512 → /Dc/0/Voltage` (autonomous mode)

info:
Full Charge Logic Node (Victron / DVCC)

Operating modes:
auto: Full charge every N calendar weeks (FULL_CHARGE_INTERVAL)
manual: Forces full charge immediately (DVCC=0V / RCV)
bulk: Permanent conservation charge (Float FLOAT_VOLTAGE)

Charge modes:
CVL Mode (AUTONOMOUS_MODE=false):
  Full charge detection via JK-BMS CVL voltage drop (DELTA_V)
Autonomous Mode (AUTONOMOUS_MODE=true):
  DVCC → RCV_VOLTAGE when full charge is due
  When v_bat >= RCV_VOLTAGE - RCV_DETECT_DELTA: hold timer starts
  After RCV_TIME_MIN minutes → Float + write history

Triggers:
- CVL from JK-BMS (onlyChanges) — CVL mode only
- Battery voltage JK-BMS — autonomous mode only
- Heartbeat once/hour (cron 0 * * * *)
- Mode inject

Context:
- last full charge (week + year + date)
- last max CVL (CVL mode)
- rcvActive / rcvHoldStart (autonomous mode)
- mode

Parameters:
DELTA_V, FLOAT_VOLTAGE, FULL_CHARGE_INTERVAL,
AUTONOMOUS_MODE, RCV_VOLTAGE, RCV_DETECT_DELTA, RCV_TIME_MIN
